Name: Keep Your Partners
Author: EssGee
Description:
This mod works by simply nulling out the first half of the "if player is not married AND is dating" argument that controls when the boyfriend/girlfriend text is printed, using a Harmony transpiler. Just let me know if any issues are encountered!

Note that the clothing shown is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] by Poltergeister!


[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.4.5
[*]Should work in multiplayer as well, though only for the player(s) who have it installed of course.
[*]As with any Harmony mod, there is a chance it won't play nicely with other Harmony mods, but it's very simple so it should hopefully be fine.
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Keep Partners
Manifest.Description: Be more poly and keep your boyfriends/girlfriends after marriage.
Manifest.Author: SG
